name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 2px solid #005fcc ring with no inner ring for focus indicators. This keeps the ring visible at 2px—thin enough to avoid clutter but thick enough to meet WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement against most backgrounds. The trade-off is slightly less visual pop than a 4px ring, but it prevents the ring from overwhelming small interactive elements or overlapping nearby content.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring fails on low-contrast patterned backgrounds where the 2px gap between ring and pattern merges the ring into the background. A 3px ring at 3:1 contrast against both light and dark patterned surfaces meets WCAG 2.2 without relying on inner/outer rings. Test it on a high-contrast checkerboard pattern to settle the argument.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 3:1 contrast against both light and dark patterned surfaces. This guarantees visibility on all backgrounds without relying on inner/outer rings or gaps that can fail on complex patterns. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring that may feel more prominent, but it eliminates the risk of disappearing on busy backgrounds while still meeting WCAG 2.2.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks feeling heavy on dense UIs where multiple elements already compete for attention. A better alternative is a 2px ring with a 1px inner offset—this maintains WCAG 2.2 contrast on patterned backgrounds without bulk. Test it on a high-contrast checkerboard at 200% zoom; if the ring remains distinct, it’s the safer choice.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #ffffff outer ring to meet WCAG 2.2 contrast on patterned backgrounds while balancing visual prominence. Ramp owns the implementation and testing against a high-contrast checkerboard at 200% zoom.
